leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the expected props structure for an Error Boundary component.
Implement class component syntax with React.Component to create an Error Boundary.
Utilize the getDerivedStateFromError lifecycle method to update component state when errors occur.
Control error state by setting boolean flags to conditionally render fallback UI.
Define componentDidCatch method to handle error logging and side effects.
Construct fallback UI elements to display when errors are caught by the boundary.
Use the Error Boundary component to wrap other components and catch their errors.
Invoke the Error Boundary in JSX by placing it as a parent wrapper around child components.
Execute conditional rendering to show either normal content or error UI based on component state.
Apply TypeScript generics to properly type Error Boundary state and props.
Store error information in component state for access within the fallback UI.
Return appropriate JSX structures from both normal render and error states.
